svg.text: Add apps manually, and keep removed apps quiet
Every account keeps + Add app in its header. Removed apps stay silent — and undoing 3 automatic adds in one app stops adding it automatically.

Copies silently — not re-added, no nag. Marked "Removed earlier" in menu.
